value.rationale: The complete third-moment invariant exposes three-edge graph patterns not visible in mean and variance. The two nonisomorphic connected 3-regular six-vertex graphs (triangular prism and K3,3) have exactly equal lower moments but a provable nonzero third-moment gap; this is a motivated distributional distinction, not a parameterized rounding exercise.
